statement: 对暴露于镉和大蒜粉补充饲料的鱼（E2组）的肾脏样本进行的光镜研究显示了一些变化。由于肾小球毛细血管肥大，肾小体充血并在小区域轻微肥大。
text_zh: 对暴露于镉和大蒜粉补充饲料的鱼（E2组）的肾脏样本进行的光镜研究显示了一些变化。由于肾小球毛细血管肥大，肾小体充血并在小区域轻微肥大。
text_en: Light microscopy studies of kidney samples from fish exposed to cadmium and garlic powder-supplemented feed (E2 group) showed some changes. Due to hypertrophy of glomerular capillaries, renal corpuscles were congested and slightly hypertrophied in small areas.
counterevidence: 观察到肾小体充血和轻微肥大等病理变化

quote: Similarly to our findings, nephrocyte cytoplasmic vacuolization, pyknotic nucleus [31, 42, 43, 44], peritubular fibrosis [45], leukocyte infiltration between renal tubules and glomeruli [35], are other lesions occurred in previous papers.
statement: 先前的研究报道了肾细胞胞质空泡化、固缩核、管周纤维化以及肾小管和肾小球之间的白细胞浸润等病变。
text_zh: 先前的研究报道了肾细胞胞质空泡化、固缩核、管周纤维化以及肾小管和肾小球之间的白细胞浸润等病变。
text_en: Previous studies reported lesions such as cytoplasmic vacuolization of renal cells, pyknotic nuclei, peritubular fibrosis, and leukocyte infiltration between renal tubules and glomeruli.

quote: Congestion and hemorrhage in kidney may be attributed to the decline in the hematological parameters as Kaoud et al. [46] and Zaki et al. [47] observed, since the hemoglobin contents are insufficient for the respiration of the tissue.
statement: 肾脏充血和出血可能归因于血液学参数的下降，因为血红蛋白含量不足以支持组织呼吸。
text_zh: 肾脏充血和出血可能归因于血液学参数的下降，因为血红蛋白含量不足以支持组织呼吸。
text_en: Kidney congestion and hemorrhage may be attributed to the decrease in hematological parameters, because hemoglobin content is insufficient to support tissue respiration.

quote: Rothstein (1959) cited by Hadi [48] argued that metals affect permeability of cell membranes and resulting in inhibition of the ion-transporting systems causes disturbances in fluid transport from and into cells.
statement: 金属影响细胞膜的通透性，导致离子转运系统受抑制，从而引起细胞内外液体运输的紊乱。
text_zh: 金属影响细胞膜的通透性，导致离子转运系统受抑制，从而引起细胞内外液体运输的紊乱。
text_en: Metals affect cell membrane permeability, leading to inhibition of ion transport systems, thereby causing disturbances in intracellular and extracellular fluid transport.
outcome: 细胞膜通透性与离子转运

quote: Hadi and Alwachi, (1995) [49] explain incidence of congestion and hemorrhage in catfish, Clarias lazera, kidney under aluminum exposure in that the metal integrate with cell membranes causing a large amount of fluid filtrate, as well as disperse of serum albumin and red blood cells in the interstitial substance due to destruction of capillaries endothelium.
statement: 铝暴露下鲶鱼肾脏出现充血和出血的原因是金属整合到细胞膜中导致大量滤液，以及由于毛细血管内皮破坏导致血清白蛋白和红细胞分散在间质物质中。
text_zh: 铝暴露下鲶鱼肾脏出现充血和出血的原因是金属整合到细胞膜中导致大量滤液，以及由于毛细血管内皮破坏导致血清白蛋白和红细胞分散在间质物质中。
text_en: The cause of congestion and hemorrhage in the kidneys of catfish under aluminum exposure is that metal integration into cell membranes leads to a large amount of filtrate, and serum albumin and red blood cells are dispersed in interstitial material due to capillary endothelial damage.

quote: Weber et al. (2003) [50] showed that pyknotic and fragmented nuclei, as indicators of apoptotic and necrotic cell death, were mostly observed in the epithelial cells of proximal and distal convoluted tubules and rarely associated with other renal cells.
statement: 固缩核和碎裂核作为凋亡和坏死细胞死亡的指标，主要观察到在近曲小管和远曲小管的上皮细胞中，很少与其他肾细胞相关。
text_zh: 固缩核和碎裂核作为凋亡和坏死细胞死亡的指标，主要观察到在近曲小管和远曲小管的上皮细胞中，很少与其他肾细胞相关。
text_en: Pyknotic nuclei and fragmented nuclei, as indicators of apoptotic and necrotic cell death, were mainly observed in the epithelial cells of the proximal and distal tubules, rarely associated with other renal cells.

quote: Moreover, they added that the occurrence of dilated tubules appears to be a consequence of dead and dying epithelial cells, while a thickening of Bowman’s capsule can arise as a result of fibrosis.
statement: 扩张的小管似乎是死亡和垂死上皮细胞的结果，而鲍曼氏囊增厚可能是纤维化的结果。
text_zh: 扩张的小管似乎是死亡和垂死上皮细胞的结果，而鲍曼氏囊增厚可能是纤维化的结果。
text_en: The dilated tubules appear to be the result of dead and dying epithelial cells, while Bowman's capsule thickening may be the result of fibrosis.
outcome: 肾小管扩张与鲍曼氏囊增厚

quote: Dietary lipid content affects not only the physiological health but also the flesh quality of fish (Ma et al., 2017).
statement: 日粮脂质含量不仅影响鱼类的生理健康，还影响其肉质品质。
text_zh: 日粮脂质含量不仅影响鱼类的生理健康，还影响其肉质品质。
text_en: Dietary lipid content not only affects the physiological health of fish, but also affects their meat quality.

quote: Exercise training seems to be a potential measure for improving the quality of cultivable fish.
statement: 运动训练似乎是提高养殖鱼类质量的一种潜在措施。
text_zh: 运动训练似乎是提高养殖鱼类质量的一种潜在措施。
text_en: Exercise training appears to be a potential measure for improving the quality of farmed fish.

quote: Two-way ANOVA analysis was first used to detect the possible interaction between ET and the dietary lipid level.
statement: 使用双因素方差分析检测运动训练与日粮脂质水平之间的潜在交互作用。
text_zh: 使用双因素方差分析检测运动训练与日粮脂质水平之间的潜在交互作用。
text_en: Two-way analysis of variance was used to detect potential interactions between exercise training and dietary lipid levels.

quote: Under the same conditions (exercise training or no exercise training), an independent samples t test was used to analyze whether there was a significant difference between fish fed diets with different fat contents.
statement: 在相同条件下，使用独立样本t检验分析不同脂肪含量日粮喂养的鱼之间是否存在显著差异。
text_zh: 在相同条件下，使用独立样本t检验分析不同脂肪含量日粮喂养的鱼之间是否存在显著差异。
text_en: Under the same conditions, an independent samples t-test was used to analyze whether there were significant differences between fish fed diets with different fat contents.

quote: Similarly, under the same dietary fat content (medium-fat diet or high-fat diet), the independent samples t- test was used to analyze whether there was a significant difference between fish at exercise training and no exercise training).
statement: 同样，在相同的日粮脂肪含量下，使用独立样本t检验分析运动训练鱼与非运动训练鱼之间是否存在显著差异。
text_zh: 同样，在相同的日粮脂肪含量下，使用独立样本t检验分析运动训练鱼与非运动训练鱼之间是否存在显著差异。
text_en: Similarly, at the same dietary fat content, an independent samples t-test was used to analyze whether there were significant differences between exercise-trained fish and non-exercise-trained fish.

quote: The experimental fish were acclimated for four weeks in fiberglass tanks (883 L water volume; 150 cm in diameter; 50 cm water depth) to adapt to the laboratory conditions.
statement: 实验鱼在玻璃钢水箱（水量883升；直径150厘米；水深50厘米）中驯化四周以适应实验室条件。
text_zh: 实验鱼在玻璃钢水箱（水量883升；直径150厘米；水深50厘米）中驯化四周以适应实验室条件。
text_en: Experimental fish were acclimated for four weeks in fiberglass-reinforced plastic tanks (water volume: 883 liters; diameter: 150 cm; water depth: 50 cm) to adapt to laboratory conditions.

quote: In the ET group, the water flow was 16 cm s −1 (approximately 1.2 body lengths per second), which was induced with a water pump.
statement: 在运动训练组中，水流速度为16厘米/秒（约每秒1.2个体长），由水泵诱导产生。
text_zh: 在运动训练组中，水流速度为16厘米/秒（约每秒1.2个体长），由水泵诱导产生。
text_en: In the exercise training group, water flow velocity was 16 cm/s (about 1.2 body lengths per second), induced by a pump.

quote: The water pump functioned during 9:00–11:00, 14:00–16:00, and 18:00–20:00.
During the exercise trains, the fish were fed to apparent satiation three times per day (8:30, 13:00 and 17:00) for 3 weeks.
statement: 在运动训练期间，每天三次（8:30、13:00和17:00）将鱼喂至表观饱食状态，持续3周。
text_zh: 在运动训练期间，每天三次（8:30、13:00和17:00）将鱼喂至表观饱食状态，持续3周。
text_en: During exercise training, fish were fed to apparent satiation three times daily (8:30, 13:00 and 17:00) for 3 weeks.

quote: the fish in all groups were weighed after being deprived of food for 24 h.
statement: 所有组的鱼在禁食24小时后称重。
text_zh: 所有组的鱼在禁食24小时后称重。
text_en: Fish in all groups were weighed after a 24-hour fast.

quote: 6 fish from each treatment were sacrificed by anesthetization with MS-222 (100 mg L −1 tricaine methane sulfonate, Argent Chemical Laboratories Inc., Redmond, WA, USA).
statement: 每个处理组取6条鱼，使用MS-222（100毫克/升三卡因甲磺酸盐）麻醉后处死。
text_zh: 每个处理组取6条鱼，使用MS-222（100毫克/升三卡因甲磺酸盐）麻醉后处死。

quote: ET significantly reduced the weight gain rate of fish regardless of dietary fat content.
statement: 运动训练显著降低了鱼类的增重率，无论日粮脂肪含量如何。
text_zh: 运动训练显著降低了鱼类的增重率，无论日粮脂肪含量如何。
text_en: Exercise training significantly reduced the weight gain rate of fish, regardless of dietary fat content.

quote: The hepatosomatic index (HSI) in the HFN group was significantly higher than that in the MFN group (Fig. 1 B).
statement: 未运动的高脂日粮组（HFN）的肝体指数显著高于未运动的中脂日粮组（MFN）。
text_zh: 未运动的高脂日粮组（HFN）的肝体指数显著高于未运动的中脂日粮组（MFN）。
text_en: The hepatosomatic index of the non-exercised high-fat diet group (HFN) was significantly higher than that of the non-exercised medium-fat diet group (MFN).

quote: Balıkların yakalanmasında elektroşoker ile çeşitli ağlar kullanılmıştır.
statement: Araştırma kapsamında balıkların yakalanması için elektroşok cihazı ve çeşitli ağlar kullanılmıştır.
text_en: Araştırma kapsamında balıkların yakalanması için elektroşok cihazı ve çeşitli ağlar kullanılmıştır.

quote: Increased body fat levels due to excessive energy intake had negative impacts on flesh quality and liver health, and ET could improve liver health and muscle flavour by burning this energy.
statement: 由于能量摄入过多导致的体脂水平升高对肉质和肝脏健康有负面影响，而有氧运动训练（ET）可以通过燃烧这些能量来改善肝脏健康和肌肉风味。
text_zh: 由于能量摄入过多导致的体脂水平升高对肉质和肝脏健康有负面影响，而有氧运动训练（ET）可以通过燃烧这些能量来改善肝脏健康和肌肉风味。
text_en: Elevated body fat levels caused by excessive energy intake have negative effects on meat quality and liver health, while aerobic exercise training (ET) can improve liver health and muscle flavor by burning this energy.

quote: Studies in this experiment have indicated that appropriate ET can promote liver health in farmed fish.
statement: 本实验的研究表明，适当的有氧运动训练可以促进养殖鱼类的肝脏健康。
text_zh: 本实验的研究表明，适当的有氧运动训练可以促进养殖鱼类的肝脏健康。
text_en: This experiment's research shows that appropriate aerobic exercise training can promote liver health in farmed fish.

quote: During the acclimation period, all fish were fed commercial feed twice a day.
statement: 在适应期间，所有鱼每天喂食两次商业饲料。
text_zh: 在适应期间，所有鱼每天喂食两次商业饲料。
text_en: During the acclimation period, all fish were fed commercial feed twice daily.

quote: The two groups were set as the medium-fat diet (MFD) and high-fat diet (HFD) groups.
statement: 两组分别设置为中脂饮食组和高脂饮食组。
text_zh: 两组分别设置为中脂饮食组和高脂饮食组。
text_en: The two groups were set as a medium-fat diet group and a high-fat diet group.

quote: During the feeding trial, the fish were fed to apparent satiation three times per day (8:30, 13:00 and 17:00) for 8 weeks.
statement: 在饲养试验期间，鱼每天三次（8:30、13:00和17:00）被喂至表观饱腹状态，持续8周。
text_zh: 在饲养试验期间，鱼每天三次（8:30、13:00和17:00）被喂至表观饱腹状态，持续8周。
text_en: During the feeding trial, fish were fed to apparent satiation three times daily (8:30, 13:00, and 17:00) for 8 weeks.

quote: Water temperature was recorded daily and maintained at 30.05 ± 1.60 °C.
statement: 水温每日记录并维持在30.05 ± 1.60 °C。
text_zh: 水温每日记录并维持在30.05 ± 1.60 °C。
text_en: Water temperature was recorded daily and maintained at 30.05 ± 1.60 °C.

quote: The dissolved oxygen content was maintained above 7.5 mg L −1 and the ammonia nitrogen content was −1 .
statement: 溶解氧含量维持在7.5 mg/L以上，氨氮含量为−1（原文数据缺失或错误）。
text_zh: 溶解氧含量维持在7.5 mg/L以上，氨氮含量为−1（原文数据缺失或错误）。
text_en: Dissolved oxygen content is maintained above 7.5 mg/L, and ammonia nitrogen content is −1 (original data missing or erroneous).
limitations: 氨氮数值在引文中显示不完整

quote: The fishes were caught by electrofishing and using gill nets.
statement: 鱼类通过电捕鱼和刺网捕获。
text_zh: 鱼类通过电捕鱼和刺网捕获。
text_en: Fish were captured by electrofishing and gillnets.

quote: The feeding intensity was the lowest in the length groups of 15-17 cm during summer 2012, in 3-5 cm length group in autumn 2012 and in 24-26 cm length group in spring.
statement: 2012年夏季15-17厘米长度组、2012年秋季3-5厘米长度组和春季24-26厘米长度组的摄食强度最低。
text_zh: 2012年夏季15-17厘米长度组、2012年秋季3-5厘米长度组和春季24-26厘米长度组的摄食强度最低。
text_en: The feeding intensity was lowest in the 15-17 cm length group in summer 2012, the 3-5 cm length group in autumn 2012, and the 24-26 cm length group in spring.

quote: HFD significantly decreased the α-linolenic acid (LNA) content whether fish received ET or not.
statement: 无论鱼是否接受运动训练，高脂日粮（HFD）都显著降低了α-亚麻酸（LNA）的含量。
text_zh: 无论鱼是否接受运动训练，高脂日粮（HFD）都显著降低了α-亚麻酸（LNA）的含量。
text_en: Regardless of whether the fish received exercise training, the high-fat diet (HFD) significantly reduced the content of alpha-linolenic acid (LNA).

quote: ET increased the muscle glycogen content, which may be a way for experienced fish to expand their energy reserves to adapt to exercise training.
statement: 运动训练增加了肌肉糖原含量，这可能是有经验的鱼类扩大能量储备以适应运动训练的一种方式。
text_zh: 运动训练增加了肌肉糖原含量，这可能是有经验的鱼类扩大能量储备以适应运动训练的一种方式。
text_en: Exercise training increased muscle glycogen content, which may be a way for experienced fish to expand energy reserves in response to exercise training.

quote: Currently, farmed fish have been partly fed a HFD to accelerate growth for greater economic benefits.
statement: 目前，部分养殖鱼类被喂食高脂饲料以加速生长从而获得更大的经济效益。
text_zh: 目前，部分养殖鱼类被喂食高脂饲料以加速生长从而获得更大的经济效益。
text_en: Currently, some farmed fish are fed high-fat diets to accelerate growth and thereby achieve greater economic benefits.

quote: However, high-fat feed causes a large accumulation of fat in fish bodies which not only affects the health of the fish but also reduces its flesh quality (Lv et al., 2020).
statement: 然而，高脂饲料导致鱼体内大量脂肪积累，这不仅影响鱼的健康，还会降低其肉质。
text_zh: 然而，高脂饲料导致鱼体内大量脂肪积累，这不仅影响鱼的健康，还会降低其肉质。
text_en: However, high-fat feed led to a large accumulation of fat in the fish body, which not only affected the health of the fish but also reduced its meat quality.

quote: The quality of fish is affected by various factors, such as water temperature, rearing conditions, pre- and postslaughter handling and storage methods (Digre et al., 2011).
statement: 鱼的品质受到多种因素的影响，如水温、饲养条件、屠宰前后处理及储存方法。
text_zh: 鱼的品质受到多种因素的影响，如水温、饲养条件、屠宰前后处理及储存方法。
text_en: The quality of fish is affected by multiple factors, such as water temperature, rearing conditions, pre- and post-slaughter handling, and storage methods.
